title: Mallard Duck Movement
text:
Mallard Duck Movement
Lake Constance lies in Central Europe, where Germany, Switzerland, and Austria meet. This site follows 52 mallards across 83,279 GPS fixes from the PPBDS misc.tutorials dataset.
Most fixes cluster near the lake. In spring and summer, some tracked ducks range north and east, reaching about 54°N and 24°E; by autumn and winter, fixes are concentrated back near Lake Constance. Explore the Map and Seasons pages to see their locations and seasonal patterns.
